children: Kestra Medical reported first-quarter fiscal 2027 results for the period ended July 31, 2026, with revenue of $31.0 million and gross profit of $17.5 million. The company expanded gross margin to 56.5% and posted a GAAP net loss of $44.1 million for the quarter. Kestra raised its FY27 revenue guidance to $141 million, up from prior guidance of $137 million.
Revenue: $31.0 million for the three months ended July 31, 2026 (60% increase versus prior year period).
Gross profit: $17.5 million; gross margin: 56.5% (prior year period: 45.7%).
GAAP operating expenses: $55.2 million for the quarter.
GAAP net loss: $44.1 million for the quarter; net loss per share: $(0.75) (basic and diluted).
Adjusted EBITDA (non-GAAP): loss of $24.0 million for the quarter.
Revenue growth driven by wearable cardioverter defibrillator (WCD) market expansion and competitive share gains.
Geographic expansion into new sales territories contributed to top-line growth.
Higher mix of in-network patients and improvements in revenue cycle management increased realized revenues and margins.
Ongoing commercial expansion and accelerated investment in key R&D programs drove increased operating expenses.

Liquidity position: cash and cash equivalents plus investments totaled $244.7 million as of July 31, 2026; including committed unused term loan availability, total liquidity approximately $320 million.
